jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative, French or German Speaking (London, United Kingdom)
jobs.description_text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As an Inside Sales Representative, you’ll play an important role in helping our existing customers scale while managing requests and closing deals from a large book of accounts. You’ll build a strong foundation of knowledge across our product platform and internal sales processes while partnering with Support, Order Management, and Marketing. You’ll also gain experience qualifying and routing inbound prospects to an aligned Account Executive. Ultimately, this experience will help you serve customers efficiently and support your own career development in Sales. As a founding member of this new team, you're adaptable and eager to contribute to how the strategy of this function evolves over time.

This is a full time role that can be held from our London hub.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Communicate with existing customer accounts through email, Zoom, and Ironclad about Figma’s platform and pricing 
  • Close inbound sales requests for subscription expansions, including adding products or licenses, creating new instances, and upgrading to the Enterprise Plan
  • Manage inbound billing requests (such as processing renewals and changing payment term/method) 
  • Close targeted outbound account renewals 
  • Qualify and handle inbound sales requests 
  • Partner with Marketing to run proactive campaigns that maximize expansion/retention across all products 

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Desire to build career in Sales - ultimately working towards Senior Inside Sales Representative and Account Executive roles at Figma 
  • Strong technical aptitude with ability to learn new products, processes, and policies as we go 
  • Collaboration across multiple teams (such as Sales, Support, Billing, and Marketing)
  • Inherent curiosity and commitment to ongoing learning, adaptable and comfortable navigating frequent change, and high achiever with a strong inner motivation to over-achieve
  • Fluent in French or German language

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • B2B SaaS experience 
  • Customer-facing Sales/Support experience 

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status

jobs.title: Mid Market Account Executive, Financial Services
jobs.description_text:
Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

As one of our Mid Market Account Executives, you will fill a key role in acquiring new Mid Market level customers, primarily in the Financial Services sector and spreading the Gong gospel across the EMEA region. This position reports directly to our Head of Enterprise Sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Manage prospects from lead to close
  • Land new business within greenfield territory
  • Clearly articulate and demonstrate our Gong value proposition, creating excitement and enthusiasm among prospects
  • Regularly iterate messaging that will scale our outbound prospecting engine
  • Engage and educate senior executives on the importance of the emerging Revenue Intelligence industry and validate Gong as the leader in this new market
  • Partner with our SDR, Sales and Sales Engineering teams to develop account-based sales strategies to uncover value for all go-to-market department leaders
QUALIFICATIONS 
  • 3+ years of relevant SaaS Sales experience. Selling to the Financial Services sector is not a must but is preferable.
  • Track record of overachieving revenue targets of 1M+ and successfully navigating and closing six-figure deals
  • Previous SaaS and enterprise software experience
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Must be able to work hybrid with three days in the office and two days from home
YOU ARE
  • A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment
  • Passionate about providing exceptional customer experiences
  • Creative, resourceful, detail-oriented, and well-organized
  • Experienced in selling transformation/visionary solutions, especially where there isn't an obvious budget (demand creation vs. fulfilment)
  • Comfortable leading technical presentation/demo and owning full customer lifecycle from prospect to close
  • A team player with high integrity and grit

NOTE: This position is initially remote with the intention of being hybrid once we open a London office.

Gong believes in offering competitive compensation and benefits tailored to the local region. Gong is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, age, or any other basis protected by law.

To review Gong's privacy policy, visit www.gong.io/privacy-policy/ for more details.

jobs.description_text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

At Figma, we're building tools that help teams design, build, and ship better products together. Figma Make enables teams to go from prompt to production code, and the Figma agent is a purpose-built design agent that edits files directly on the Figma canvas.

We're looking for a deeply technical product leader to lead the four teams responsible for Figma's Roundtripping area: Code Context, Design to Code, Code to Design, and Code Platform. You'll manage and grow a team of Product Managers while partnering closely with engineering, design, data, and research leaders.

This team builds the products and platform capabilities that help design and code move fluently together. You'll set the strategy for improving connecting customer codebases to Figma.

This is a full-time role that can be held from our London hub or remotely within the UK.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Lead the product aspects of the four teams driving Figma's Roundtripping area - Code Context, Design to Code and Code to Design, and Code Platform
  • Set vision, strategy, and goals for how design and code stay in sync at Figma
  • Own Design to Code and Code to Design workflows end to end, including quality measurement, improvement, and discoverability
  • Guide the development of the code-context systems and translation primitives that power agentic workflows and round-tripping between design and code
  • Manage and develop three Product Managers, hire the team's open Product Manager role, and establish a high bar for product management craft
  • Partner with leaders across engineering, design, data, and research to make technical product decisions and serve needs across Figma's product suite
  • Establish a strong operating cadence across the area and own adoption goals for MCP and Design to Code/Code to Design workflows

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience managing Product Managers, with a proven track record of hiring, calibrating, and developing talent

jobs.title: Director of Data Products
jobs.description_text:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.
We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.
Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.
In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.
But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.
Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.
Why this role
Every one of Multiverse's 800+ employees needs data to do their job well, and in the AI era - our ability to leverage data is more important than ever!
As Director of Data Products, you will own the platform, the products, the tools, the processes and the self-serve layer, so that the answer arrives before the request does.
You will be a force-multiplier for the quality, velocity and impact of Multiverse's decision making, and a driving force behind how data and AI are leveraged across the entire business. You will ensure that how we interact with data and deliver data products fully realises the potential of AI.
You will sit in the Data & Insight leadership team, reporting to our VP of Data & Insight, with a seat in company-wide planning and governance forums. You will manage 8 analytics engineers and developers within a wider team of ~20, collaborating with senior stakeholders across the org to coordinate a complex set of competing needs.
What you'll own
Data leverage across Multiverse
The platform, products and self-serve layer that ~800 people use to find, understand and act on our data — reducing the dependency on Data & Insight to answer questions others could answer themselves.
Direction on tooling: evaluate the options, make the call, take the organisation through the change.
Curation of our semantic layer so it covers Multiverse's core business concepts, data and metrics — with clear ownership and stewardship agreed with Domain D&I Leads and business stakeholders, and core architecture aligned with the Director of Data Engineering.
Governance embedded through the platform itself — quality, definitions, stewardship, access — so that trust and speed stop being a trade-off.
Real adoption, through documentation, training and support that reaches every relevant domain. Optimising the user experience alongside secure controls and seamless interconnectivity (APIs, MCPs).
Cross-functional roadmap delivery
D&I's operational planning process: around 50 quarterly projects properly scoped, clearly defined and appropriately resourced, with capacity reallocated as priorities move.
Representation of D&I in company-wide planning and governance forums, bringing a data lens to decisions being made elsewhere in the business.
A roadmap that reflects genuine business priority rather than the loudest request, with data needs surfaced early.
Progress against milestones — risks identified ahead of time, blockers raised, solutions coordinated.
Operational excellence
Driving the team's cycle planning, standups and retrospectives, run so they are genuinely useful and action-oriented.
Standards, playbooks and best practice for how work is scoped, how handoffs happen and how outputs are documented — with AI embedded where it creates real leverage.
Fair triage of inbound support and feature requests, and an escalation route for issues that cross domain boundaries.
D&I's own operational metrics — project velocity, support throughput, self-ser
